study: Order-specific conditional skill induction and fresh-patient retention audit
status: protocol fixed before new patient inference and outcome evaluation
development: Reuse v52 reflection192, proposal64 and guard64. These are historically exposed development sets; no v52 audit labels are used in learning.
audit: 256 new eICU patients, one stay each, exclude ALL v25 and v52 members; half one disease-system category, half at least two. Same old guard hospital partition; not unseen hospitals.
task: Predict recorded orders entered at ICU hours6-12 from context available by hour6. Keep zero-target cases. HICL, route, dosage string and frequency string; not full clinical prescription correctness.
base: Unchanged v52 prompt, catalogue, local greedy256-token actors and compatible complete-JSON decoder. Qwen3-4B and Llama3.2-3B on identical256 audit patients.
learning: Six cumulative32-case rounds, seeds53/153/253. Automatic symbolic error induction in a fixed interpreter. Learn drug-specific add/remove/replace joint-template programs, recorded diagnosis path condition and empirical exception. This is supervised program/memory induction, not weight learning or autonomous invention of pharmacology/tool code.
conditions: At least two levels of a recorded diagnostic path; optionally prior record present/absent for the target drug. Missing records do not assert clinical absence. Exceptions are diagnosis paths or target-drug prior-record status supported by at least two training cases with a component error increase.
templates: Complete tuples observed in at least three distinct reflection patients; no audit-label-derived templates. Expose identical reflection-derived template memory to replay control. Candidate restrictions do not block executing learned tuples outside actor catalogue.
promotion: At least4 applicable and3 helped reflection patients; every training error component non-increasing and total decreases. Proposal requires same aggregate Pareto improvement. Guard requires no aggregate component increase, no individual increase in missed drugs, and at least one actual changed order. Up to3 guard trials/round and one accepted rule/round. Rejected state-program pairs cached. Neither gate certifies clinical appropriateness.
controls: shuffled reflection labels with true development gates
primary: Per-patient missing drug identities, extra drug identities, symmetric difference of complete native4 tuples. Separately quantify joint-field mismatch among shared identities so deletion cannot masquerade as field repair.
retention: All rounds of all three streams, transferred unchanged to both backbones; single/multiple-system strata. No checkpoint picked on audit. 4000 paired patient bootstrap draws; report95% marginal intervals and Bonferroni upper bounds across3 errors x3 seeds x2 models.
claim_gate: Strong hypothesis requires all three errors to reliably decline across all final streams/models, nondegradation in multiple-system patients, actual counterexample-bearing skills, and completed independent clinical appropriateness review. Otherwise report unsupported, never manufacture updates.
appropriateness: Research rubric grounded in WHO prescribing process and MAI dimensions; two blinded reviewers, unknown/not assessable explicit. Mechanistic scope and source support of each skill also reviewed. No annotation fabricated. Automated metformin renal-label checker is a narrow, researcher-engineered tri-state tool, not a full appropriateness evaluator.
privacy_budget: All patient data and model execution local. New API spend0. Standing USD10 cap; earlier aggregate-only API spend0.085203. Public exports aggregate only. Patient-derived rule bodies and templates stay restricted.
